name: os构建器2
readme:
目前以支持C和python打包的静态/动态elf
目前支持的架构如下：
x86_64	x86_64 / AMD64	64	无（本机）	bzImage	x86_64-efi	BIOS/EFI
i386	i386 / x86 32-bit	32	i386-linux-gnu-	bzImage	i386-efi	BIOS/EFI
arm64	ARM64 / AArch64	64	aarch64-linux-gnu-	Image.gz	arm64-efi	U-Boot/EFI
arm	ARM 32-bit (ARMv7)	32	arm-linux-gnueabihf-	zImage	arm-efi	U-Boot/EFI
riscv64	RISC-V 64-bit	64	riscv64-linux-gnu-	Image	riscv64-efi	OpenSBI/U-Boot
ppc64le	PowerPC 64-bit LE	64	powerpc64le-linux-gnu-	zImage.epapr	powerpc-ieee1275	IEEE1275
mips64	MIPS 64-bit (malta)	64	mips64-linux-gnu-	vmlinux.gz	mips-arc	ARC
内核配置如下：
